scenes.say: Formula One wants V8 engines back. Just not the screaming V8s that raced until twenty thirteen.
The cheap idea: take today's turbo V6 and bolt on two more cylinders. That gets you roughly two litres.
Less electric power. Two hundred kilowatts instead of three hundred fifty.
A hundred kilowatts all the time, another hundred only for overtaking, like push to pass in IndyCar.
The cars should lose eighty kilos. The FIA wants them under seven hundred.
Current rules run to the end of twenty thirty, so think twenty thirty-one. Nothing is signed yet.
What the FIA decides, you'll find on LapRadar.

title: V8s are coming back to F1: what the FIA is proposing and when it could happen
